decisions.reason: The accepted six-ticket no-referral behavior is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The coded-ticket quantity change does not alter commission semantics; the accepted $35 commission is already represented separately.
Changing the number of tickets issued for a valid coded referral does not change referral-code eligibility or self-referral validation.
The coded-referral ticket quantity does not change no-referral commission allocation, and the accepted $12 amount is already represented separately.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
The logic itself sounds good to me.

After 34 mints, the leaderboard now shows 24 tickets and 19 commissions, which is perfect.

The NFT attributes are still not right, though. My screenshots show that NFT #42 has 18 tickets and 9 x $35 commissions on the leaderboard, which is correct. When I open NFT #42, the top of the page also correctly displays 18 tickets and 14 referrals. However, its attributes still report only 6 referrals and $85 in total earnings.
